Landscape Explorer Travel Agency. Landscape Explorer was founded in year 2006 by Mr Sonam Jigmath, who himself a ferocious trekker, with 8 years of prior experience as a guide, navigating Ladakh valleys and mountains, wanted to bring his expertise and share his experience with clients who are as passionate as him about trekking rough, rugged, rocky mountains but at the same time like to enjoy serene valleys, lakes and monasteries which Ladakh is famous for.
